description: Crypto price snapshot. No input: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, and DOGE against USD from Kraken's public batch ticker, fetched live on the paid call, each with the last trade price, bid and ask with the spread and its basis points, the UTC-day open with the change in dollars and percent, the 24-hour high, low, volume-weighted average price, base volume, and trade count. Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: crypto-price-snapshot
